featured.title: Latent Reasoning in Continuous Space for Unified Multimodal Models
featured.tldr: LARC lets a unified image model think in continuous hidden states instead of text before drawing, trained with a curriculum and a self-supervised information-gain reward, and it improves with more thinking.

featured.title: Nemotron 3.5 Super and Lightning: Open, Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Hybrid Mamba-Transformer Models for Agentic AI
featured.tldr: NVIDIA's open Nemotron 3.5 Super, a 120B-parameter hybrid Mamba-Transformer mixture-of-experts with 12B active, adds a built-in drafter and 4-bit weights, reaching 51.78% on SWE-bench Pro.

featured.title: An ODE-based Sampler for Discrete Diffusion Models
featured.tldr: Exponential residual flows give discrete diffusion language models an analogue of the probability-flow ODE: after one random draw, sampling is deterministic yet provably keeps the right distributions, enabling consistency distillation.

featured.title: Weaken to Strengthen: Weakening-Induced On-Policy Self-Distillation for Large Reasoning Models
featured.tldr: WISD improves reasoning models with no labels or stronger teacher by training them toward tokens the original model prefers over a deliberately quantized or pruned copy of itself, adding 4 to 5.5 points on average.

featured.title: FlatCake: A Flat KVCache Storage Architecture for LLM Serving
featured.tldr: FlatCake stores LLM key-value caches on DRAM and SSD as equal peers rather than a DRAM-over-SSD hierarchy, keeping a 94% hit rate on a Claude Code trace where Mooncake falls to 64%.

featured.title: HexaShell: A Thin Harness for Exploring the Limits of VLM Agents as Robot Coding Agents
featured.tldr: A stock coding agent drives a simulated two-arm robot through one command line and rewrites small measurement tools after each failure; with no training it reaches 46.9% success on RoboDojo's official evaluation.

featured.title: Kronecker Delta Rule for Long Context Linear Attention
featured.tldr: KronLSTM replaces the delta rule with a Kronecker Delta Rule that edits one scalar association, giving provably bounded memory and better long-context recall than Gated DeltaNet and Mamba-3 at 1.5B scale.

featured.title: Muse Glimmer 30B: An On-Device Agentic Model
featured.tldr: Meta releases Muse Glimmer, a 30B open-weight model distilled from its frontier model to run agentic tasks locally on one RTX 5090, beating same-size open models on most tool-use benchmarks.

featured.title: TokenGate: Adapting LLMs for Fast and Memory-Efficient Prefill with Learned Token Pruning
featured.tldr: TokenGate adds a learned gate that prunes long inputs early in a pretrained transformer, cutting time-to-first-token by up to 11.3 times and peak prefill memory by up to 3.4 times with no accuracy loss.

featured.title: Towards Looped Models Done Right, Part I: Topology, Input Injection, Recurrent-State Design
featured.tldr: A matched-budget study of looped language models finds that looping a middle block between untied input and output layers works best, and that the advantage carries over to mixture-of-experts models.

featured.title: Tree-Aware Posterior Distillation for Long-Horizon Agentic Reinforcement Learning
featured.tldr: TreeOPSD branches rollouts from shared prefixes to give each agent turn credit without a critic, then trains toward a bounded target, improving deep-research accuracy of Qwen3 agents by up to 4.97 points over GRPO.

featured.title: Intern Lumina U2: A Multi-Codebook Diffusion Large Language Model for Omni-Visual Understanding and Image Generation
featured.tldr: Intern Lumina U2 is a diffusion language model that represents each image position with eight discrete codes, handling image, video and 3D understanding plus image generation and editing in one network trained on Ascend NPUs.
